name: Sidon
overview: Sidon, also called Zidon, was the firstborn son of Canaan and marked the northern boundary of the Canaanite territory, as noted in Genesis 10:15 and 10:19. It was designated by Jacob as the border of the tribe of Zebulun (Genesis 49:13) and lay on the northern boundary of the tribe of Asher, whose inhabitants failed to fully drive out the Sidonians (Judges 1:31). Though God promised the land including Sidon to Israel, the city remained partially unconquered, highlighting the challenges Israel faced in possessing their inheritance (Joshua 13:6; 19:28).
